central.unit: ₹ per kWh of battery, capped per vehicle
central.source: Ministry of Heavy Industries, Gazette of India Extraordinary, S.O. 4424(E) dated 10 August 2026, amending the PM E-DRIVE scheme (S.O. 4259(E), 29 September 2024): for registered electric two-wheelers from 1 April 2025 to 31 March 2028, ₹2,500 per kWh, capped at ₹5,000 per vehicle, only up to ₹1.5 lakh ex-factory price, and limited to the lower of that or 15% of the ex-factory price. Fund-limited: it closes early if the outlay runs out. Claims close 31 December 2027. Given as an upfront price reduction at purchase (Lok Sabha unstarred question 670, 3 February 2026), so a dealer's price already includes it. Only models approved under the scheme qualify (pmedrive.heavyindustries.gov.in).

purchase.unit: ₹ per kWh of battery, capped per vehicle, by year of registration
purchase.source: Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy 2026, Transport Department notification F. No. JC/EV/TPT/2026/02/281, Delhi Gazette Extraordinary No. 169, 30 June 2026, in force from 1 July 2026 (transport.delhi.gov.in). Para 4.2: ex-showroom price up to ₹2.25 lakh; for registration in the first year from the date of notification ₹10,000 per kWh up to ₹30,000, second year ₹6,600 per kWh up to ₹20,000, third year ₹3,300 per kWh up to ₹10,000; plug-in and battery-swapping models. Para 4.1: paid by direct benefit transfer to Delhi residents for vehicles bought and registered in Delhi, on an application within 30 days of the registration certificate, within 60 days of applying; only models approved by the Transport Department's committee. Years here are counted from the notification date, 30 June 2026.

scrapping.source: Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy 2026 (as above), para 4.6.1: ₹10,000 for buying a new electric two-wheeler within six months of the certificate of deposit for scrapping a Delhi-registered BS-IV or older two-wheeler, paid to the owner of the scrapped vehicle by direct benefit transfer.

roadTaxWaiver.unit: share of road tax and registration fee waived
roadTaxWaiver.source: Delhi Electric Vehicle Policy 2026 (as above), para 4.7.1: all electric vehicles bought and registered in Delhi during the policy period get a 100% waiver of road tax for the vehicle's life and of the registration fee at registration. The policy runs to 31 March 2030.
